title: Freelance Contract Flow - Scope to Milestone Cash
description: A managed freelance workflow from proposal through milestone billing.
headline: Move approved scope into a signed engagement and billable milestones.
subheadline: Capture the brief once, render the proposal, stage signature through an approved provider, and tie each invoice to accepted work.
buyer_signal: Freelancers rebuild scopes from old documents and manually reconcile signatures, milestone acceptance, invoices, and reminders.
outcome: Every invoice traces to signed terms and accepted work.
before: Scope, terms, signatures, delivery notes, and invoices live in separate tools with no durable milestone link.
after: An approved brief becomes a proposal, external signature receipt, owned milestone ledger, and invoice draft tied to acceptance.

steps.name: Scope
steps.detail: Capture outcomes, deliverables, exclusions, dates, and budget.

steps.name: Proposal
steps.detail: Render scope, terms, milestones, and price.

steps.name: E-sign
steps.detail: Stage an approved provider handoff without sending.

steps.name: Billing
steps.detail: Draft invoices only after accepted-work receipts.

benefits.title: Stop scope drift early
benefits.detail: Exclusions, dependencies, and change control appear before signature.

benefits.title: Know what is billable
benefits.detail: Each milestone has an owner, acceptance evidence, and due date.

benefits.title: Follow up with context
benefits.detail: Invoice and reminder tasks stay bound to the accepted deliverable.

faq.question: Does this provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. The freelancer supplies approved terms and obtains legal review when needed.

faq.question: Which signature provider is used?
faq.answer: The starter keeps a provider-neutral boundary. Documenso was excluded because its current root license is AGPLv3.

faq.question: Does it send contracts or invoices?
faq.answer: No. It stages payloads and tasks only; every external send remains disabled.

faq.question: Can it support deposits and multiple milestones?
faq.answer: Yes. The production mapping can represent approved deposits, acceptance gates, and invoice schedules.
